character:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: New master mascot / IP for Leaf, a modern premium desktop reading app.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE showing minimalist cheerful character app icons; it is not an edit target. Borrow bold simplified forms, limited color palette, tiny facial features, broad smooth shapes and subtly dimensional rendering; design an ORIGINAL FROG character.
Primary request: One charming sophisticated frog reading companion. This must look like a character that belongs to the attached family of stylish close-cropped icon illustrations, not a realistic animal and not a toy photograph.
Subject: A sage-green frog with a wide soft rounded head and two prominent rounded raised eye humps. Two warm ivory eye patches with small vertical dark graphite oval pupils, gentle relaxed gaze. One simple short upturned smile, no separate nose. Compact pear-shaped body, no neck, small rounded arms and two broad simple webbed feet without thin fingers. A distinctive broad head silhouette with eye humps defines the identity. Head around 55 percent of total height. Skin muted sage #8FA88B, darker green along shaded edges; warm ivory belly. No dots or skin pattern.
Pose: seated, holding one small open book with ivory pages and muted dark forest-green cover, eyes directed toward the reader with quiet curiosity, paws rest naturally on book edges. Keep book below the smile; feet and full head visible. Absolutely only one frog.
Style/medium: Minimal soft dimensional illustration matching reference, almost flat broad colors with restrained low-relief volume and smooth matte surfaces. Editorial, fresh, contemporary, high-end. No fur, no skin texture, no outlines, no dramatic 3D shine, no glossy plastic. Soft upper-left studio light and gentle ambient form shading.
Composition/framing: Single complete full-body frog centered on a square canvas with about 12 percent safe margin on each side. Slight three-quarter frontal view, almost straight on. Finished professional master character asset.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent alpha background, no background fill, no pedestal, no ground plane, no external shadow, no setting or other props.
Color palette: Sage-green frog #8FA88B, warm paper ivory #F5F1DF, dark forest-green book cover #445A51, graphite pupils and smile #26322C. Restrained 4-color system with subtle form shading.
Constraints: no clothes, no glasses, no crown, no hat, no blush, no hearts, no sparkles, no eyelashes, no realistic frog limbs, no text, no logos, no watermark, no grid. Do not copy any single existing character in the reference. Output only one finished transparent frog-reading master asset.
icon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE finished app icon for Leaf, a modern desktop reading app, matching a new original frog IP.
Input images: Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE family of beautifully simplified character app icons. Image 2 is the NEW FROG IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve that frog's broad green head, two round eye humps, ivory eye patches, dark vertical oval pupils, short smiling mouth and overall friendly personality. Image 2 is NOT a composition reference; do not include the book or full body.
Primary request: A premium clean frog-character app icon in exactly the visual language of Image 1: bold large color fields, intimate tight face crop, minimal facial features, only softly suggested dimension.
Composition: One rounded-square icon tile with a deep forest green background #344D43. The tile fills 92 percent of the square canvas with 4 percent transparent margin and smoothly rounded corners of radius around 22 percent of tile width. An oversized sage-green frog face sits low and just slightly toward the right, both round eye humps fully visible with breathing room, the lower face and shoulders intentionally cropped by the bottom of the tile. Frog fills about 90 percent of the tile width and 85 percent tile height, friendly face occupies almost the whole icon with broad clear curved geometry. Round raised eye humps with warm ivory patches and dark vertical oval pupils; simple small curved smile, no nose. A naturally confident and calm slight three-quarter angle or subtle head tilt, not a perfectly sterile symmetry. Keep both eyes recognizable.
Style: Very simplified smooth 2.5D low-relief illustration. Broad muted sage-green #8FA88B face, warm ivory eyes #F5F1DF, graphite pupils and smile #26322C. Smooth almost flat broad-color shapes, tiny touch of soft ambient volume. Less dimensional than Image 2. Reference Image 1's punchy silhouette and restrained smile. Absolutely no fur, no toy-photo material, no surface texture, no lines around shapes, no glossy shine, no sparkles, no dramatic shadow. Background stays essentially solid dark muted green.
Constraints: Exactly one app icon. Character content MUST be clipped inside the rounded-square tile; no paws, ears or face escape the tile boundaries. Genuine alpha transparency only OUTSIDE the tile. Entire tile interior must remain opaque. No book, no hands, no realistic frog, no clothing, no accessories, no letters, no words, no logo typography, no grid, no mockup, no border, no watermark. Faces should be recognizable at 24px. Output a single clean polished square PNG app icon.
